गोवर्धन पूजा की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएं 🙏
Aaj Giriraj ji ki pooja aur annakut ka din hai.
Giriraj ji ki kripa aap sabhi par sada bani rahe.
जय श्री श्याम
Aapke ghar mein Govardhan Puja par annakut mein sabse khaas kya banta hai?

Apne naam aur photo wala Jai Shree Shyam Diwali card banayein (free): https://www.epifive.com/tools/diwali-greeting-card-with-name?theme=shyam

आज का विचार 🌿
"जाकी रही भावना जैसी। प्रभु मूरति देखी तिन तैसी॥" - रामचरितमानस (बालकांड)
Matlab: jiska jaisa bhaav hota hai, use Prabhu waise hi dikhte hain.
Bhaav ki hi baat hai, bhakti mein sabse zyada yahi mayne rakhta hai.
Aap pooja karte samay apne man mein kaunsa bhaav rakhte hain?

#JaiShreeShyam #AajKaVichar #Ramcharitmanas #Tulsidas #Bhakti #Bhaav #SanatanDharma

जाखू हनुमान मंदिर, शिमला 🙏
Shimla ki Jakhu pahadi par Hanuman ji ka yeh mandir bahut prasiddh hai.
Swipe karke 3 baatein padhiye: 108 foot ki pratima, Sanjeevani ki manyata aur Yaku rishi ki katha.
Jaise sources mein likha hai, kuch baatein manyata par aadharit hain.
Aapne Jakhu Hanuman ji ke darshan kab kiye the, ya kabhi jaane ka man hai?

शुभ संध्या 🪔
Khatu Shyam ji ke sheesh ko pranam, sandhya aarti ka samay.
दिन भर की thakaan ko aarti ki roshni mein shaant kar lijiye.
Jai Shree Shyam 🙏
Aapke ghar mein aaj sandhya aarti mein kiska smaran hua?

Chitra AI dwara banaya gaya hai (sanketik).
